question:
Select the segment in which a word has been INCORRECTLY used.

The crow held back to the piece of bread with its claws.
solution:
The correct answer is **'The crow held back'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'the crow held on'** should be used instead of** 'the crow held back'.**
 
• The phrasal verb **'held on'** means** 'grasp or support something with one's hands; keep or retain someone or something'.** (किसी के हाथ से किसी चीज को पकड़ना या सहारा देना; किसी को या किसी चीज को रखना)
 
 
• *Example: If you can just **hold on** I'll go and get some help.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The crow **held on** to the piece of bread with its claws.*
